blurb: Guests can take helicopter tours over Niagara Falls in a seven-seat Airbus H130 helicopter, flying over both the US and Canadian Falls. The company also offers a virtual reality flight simulation experience called Niagara Virtual, where guests control a VR parasail over a 360-degree video of the Falls. Tours operate year-round except on Christmas and Thanksgiving, weather permitting.
extraNote: No charge until arrival; credit card verified on site · Flight times may change day-of due to weather or unforeseen issues · Tours operate every day except Christmas and Thanksgiving, weather permitting · Free shuttle service from downtown Niagara Falls to helipad available · Rainbow Air Tourism Center, 56 Acheson Drive, Niagara Falls, NY · Year-round except Christmas and Thanksgiving Day
